policy.limitations: Twelve hand-authored prompts are broader targeted SDXL still-life coverage, not statistical population coverage. Exact normalized caption exclusion cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence. Counts/material/layout require direct inspection with uncertain allowed. Strength and no-trigger expectations are frozen now but base-only results cannot measure adapter behavior. ComfyUI dpmpp_2m/karras, CFG 7, 20 steps, 512px differs from the retained Diffusers diagnostics; same seeds do not establish sampler parity.
policy.method: Preregister all twelve prompts and thirty-six case/seed pairs. Freeze before baseline generation or any new tuning. Inspect both base conditions at all seeds. Later compare both adapter conditions at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 against the matched base controls; record all failures and uncertainty without ranking by loss or pixel differences. Legacy cases are exposed diagnostics. New holdouts are excluded from training captions, data selection and hyperparameter tuning; baseline inspection is declared exposure, not a claim of a hidden test set. Use only diagnostic regressions for C-04 development. If a holdout informs tuning, declare contamination in a new additive corpus and add fresh holdouts while preserving every old case and seed.

value.limits: CPU checkpoint load and stock loader patch registration, with exact target/shape/tensor coverage at every declared strength. Rendering separately exercises GPU execution. No attestation of all dependencies, in-memory server state, numerical parity or quality.

export.limits: Tensor names changed, payload bytes preserved; runtime acceptance is separate.

evaluation.limits: Complete owned runtime matrix and decoded PNGs; no quality verdict, promotion, loader-target mapping certificate or Diffusers sampler parity claim.

policy.limitations: Twelve hand-authored prompts are broader targeted SDXL still-life coverage, not statistical population coverage. Exact normalized caption exclusion cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence. Counts/material/layout require direct inspection with uncertain allowed. Strength and no-trigger expectations are frozen now but base-only results cannot measure adapter behavior. ComfyUI dpmpp_2m/karras, CFG 7, 20 steps, 512px differs from the retained Diffusers diagnostics; same seeds do not establish sampler parity.
policy.method: Preregister all twelve prompts and thirty-six case/seed pairs. Freeze before baseline generation or any new tuning. Inspect both base conditions at all seeds. Later compare both adapter conditions at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 against the matched base controls; record all failures and uncertainty without ranking by loss or pixel differences. Legacy cases are exposed diagnostics. New holdouts are excluded from training captions, data selection and hyperparameter tuning; baseline inspection is declared exposure, not a claim of a hidden test set. Use only diagnostic regressions for C-04 development. If a holdout informs tuning, declare contamination in a new additive corpus and add fresh holdouts while preserving every old case and seed.

image_rubrics.image_quality: Usable coherent image without malformed objects, unintended panels, frames, repeated scenes or severe artifacts.
image_rubrics.prompt_adherence: Requested objects, count, attributes, material, layout and domain are visible; unobservable details are uncertain.

value.limits: Exposed fixed cases, not an independent blind holdout or sampler-parity experiment. Review assertions require method and uncertainty; hashes are not signatures.

pair_rubrics.activation_specificity: Intended adapter style is visibly supported with the trigger and meaningfully more specific than without it; difference alone is insufficient.
pair_rubrics.preservation: Matched base comparisons show no adapter-induced content/quality regression, including unrelated prompts. Existing base failures are recorded separately.
pair_rubrics.usable_strength: Both adapter conditions at this strength remain usable and satisfy the case expectation.

policy.acceptance: All adapter-image and pair criteria must pass. Base judgments are recorded as comparison evidence, not candidate gates.
policy.failure: Any failing adapter-image or pair criterion rejects the candidate for this complete matrix.
policy.promotion: No catalog mutation or production eligibility; candidate lifecycle is separate.
policy.uncertainty: Absent failures, any uncertain/unavailable required judgment makes the decision inconclusive.

C-02 border screen is unqualified and was not used for quality decisions.

policy.acceptance: All adapter-image and pair criteria must pass. Base judgments are recorded as comparison evidence, not candidate gates.
policy.failure: Any failing adapter-image or pair criterion rejects the candidate for this complete matrix.
policy.promotion: No catalog mutation or production eligibility; candidate lifecycle is separate.
policy.uncertainty: Absent failures, any uncertain/unavailable required judgment makes the decision inconclusive.

review_metadata.limitations: Exposed fixed cases, one render per condition, small three-work training selection and known prior failures. Not blind, independent gold labels, statistical validation, a parity experiment or numerical determinism. Oil-style specificity and hidden object details remain uncertain where not visible. No training/tuning or promotion.
review_metadata.method: Direct inspection of all 288 images as 36 lossless contact sheets with 512px tiles, two columns plain/trigger and four rows base/0.25/0.5/1.0. Original 512px images 216, 222 and 223 also inspected. All image and matched-comparison judgments retained. Labels and prior baseline failures visible; no optional evaluator invoked. C-02 border screen is unqualified and was not used for quality decisions.

image_rubrics.prompt_adherence: Requested objects, count, attributes, material, layout and domain are visible; unobservable details are uncertain.
image_rubrics.image_quality: Usable coherent image without malformed objects, unintended panels, frames, repeated scenes or severe artifacts.

pair_rubrics.activation_specificity: Intended adapter style is visibly supported with the trigger and meaningfully more specific than without it; difference alone is insufficient.
pair_rubrics.preservation: Matched base comparisons show no adapter-induced content/quality regression, including unrelated prompts. Existing base failures are recorded separately.
pair_rubrics.usable_strength: Both adapter conditions at this strength remain usable and satisfy the case expectation.

policy.failure: Any failing adapter-image or pair criterion rejects the candidate for this complete matrix.
policy.uncertainty: Absent failures, any uncertain/unavailable required judgment makes the decision inconclusive.
policy.acceptance: All adapter-image and pair criteria must pass. Base judgments are recorded as comparison evidence, not candidate gates.
policy.promotion: No catalog mutation or production eligibility; candidate lifecycle is separate.

value.method: Assistant inspects all lossless 512px tiles grouped by case/seed, in base, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0 rows and plain/trigger columns. Labels visible; not blinded. Prior baseline and training failures already known. No learned evaluator invoked; C-02 screen remains unqualified. Record explicit uncertainty for style and hidden object details.
value.limits: Exposed small corpus, one generation per condition; no statistical independence, numerical determinism, sampler parity or production acceptance inferred.

value.limits: One sequential run with fresh per-job input validation and concurrent test/probe work. Server timings are reported observations, not isolated GPU profiling or a throughput qualification.

value.scope: Stopped only the identity-verified C-03 server; restored its initially stopped state.

export.limits: Tensor names changed, payload bytes preserved; runtime acceptance is separate.

cases.expectation: Exactly two yellow pears and one blue vase, intact distinct objects and a coherent table. Adapter with trigger should show oil-painted still-life appearance without adding objects, grids or borders. Compare all four conditions; baseline trigger effects do not prove learned activation.
cases.prompt: A still life of exactly two yellow pears beside one blue ceramic vase on a plain wooden table, no other objects, warm side lighting

cases.expectation: One red cube and one white cone remain distinct with coherent shadows. Without trigger the adapter should preserve photographic appearance and prompt adherence. With trigger assess whether painterly change preserves object identity and composition; record unintended fruit, flowers, repetition or distortion.
cases.prompt: A clean studio photograph of one red wooden cube and one white paper cone on a light gray surface, soft shadows, no other objects

cases.expectation: Exactly three separate red apples in one horizontal row, all fully visible. No extra fruit, vessels, panels or borders. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: A single still life of exactly three red apples in a horizontal row on an empty cream table, all three fully visible and separated, plain background

cases.expectation: Exactly one yellow ceramic cup, one handle and an empty opening; no saucer, spoon, fruit or repeated cups. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: One empty yellow ceramic cup with one handle on a bare dark wooden tabletop, a single still life with a plain gray background

cases.expectation: One green transparent bottle on the left and one orange opaque bowl on the right. Preserve material/color bindings and separation. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: One green glass bottle to the left of one orange ceramic bowl on a white table, single scene, plain backdrop, both objects fully visible

cases.expectation: Exactly two vessels: a larger white bowl behind a smaller blue cup. Preserve relative sizes, colors and front/back ordering. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: One large white ceramic bowl behind one small blue ceramic cup on a wooden table, both objects fully visible, single scene, plain background

cases.expectation: One flat plate left, one upright vase right, coherent shared table plane. No duplicated views, divided panels, fruit or flowers. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: One white plate lying flat on the left and one tall blue vase standing on the right of an otherwise empty wooden table, single continuous scene

cases.expectation: One coarse woven linen napkin and one smooth reflective silver spoon. Distinguish cloth weave from metal without turning either into fruit or repeated patterns. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: A close still life of one folded coarse beige linen napkin beside one smooth reflective silver spoon on a plain dark table

cases.expectation: Exactly two spheres: matte red clay and glossy black ceramic with distinct surface responses, coherent shadows and intact circular silhouettes. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: One matte red clay sphere beside one glossy black ceramic sphere on a light gray tabletop, soft studio light, single scene

cases.expectation: One coherent outdoor photographic landscape with snow, water reflection and blue sky. No still-life objects, panels or borders. No-trigger adapter must preserve the photographic task. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: A realistic landscape photograph of a snow-covered mountain reflected in a calm alpine lake under a clear blue sky, no buildings or people

cases.expectation: Exactly one complete blue bicycle with two connected wheels and a coherent frame, fully visible on white. No rider, fruit, vessels, repeated bikes or painterly drift without trigger. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: A side-view studio photograph of one blue bicycle with exactly two wheels against a plain white background, the entire bicycle visible, no rider

cases.expectation: One anatomically coherent brown sparrow on one bare branch, feather detail and photographic appearance without trigger. No duplicate birds, fruit, vessels or panels. Compare the base trigger effect separately from learned activation. At each adapter strength, target painterly change may occur with the trigger only while object identity, count, layout and unrelated-task content remain intact; lower strength need not improve quality monotonically.
cases.prompt: A realistic wildlife photograph of one small brown sparrow perched on a single bare branch against a soft green background, entire bird visible

policy.limitations: Twelve hand-authored prompts are broader targeted SDXL still-life coverage, not statistical population coverage. Exact normalized caption exclusion cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence. Counts/material/layout require direct inspection with uncertain allowed. Strength and no-trigger expectations are frozen now but base-only results cannot measure adapter behavior. ComfyUI dpmpp_2m/karras, CFG 7, 20 steps, 512px differs from the retained Diffusers diagnostics; same seeds do not establish sampler parity.
policy.method: Preregister all twelve prompts and thirty-six case/seed pairs. Freeze before baseline generation or any new tuning. Inspect both base conditions at all seeds. Later compare both adapter conditions at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 against the matched base controls; record all failures and uncertainty without ranking by loss or pixel differences. Legacy cases are exposed diagnostics. New holdouts are excluded from training captions, data selection and hyperparameter tuning; baseline inspection is declared exposure, not a claim of a hidden test set. Use only diagnostic regressions for C-04 development. If a holdout informs tuning, declare contamination in a new additive corpus and add fresh holdouts while preserving every old case and seed.

evaluation.limits: Complete owned runtime matrix and decoded PNGs; no quality verdict, promotion, loader-target mapping certificate or Diffusers sampler parity claim.

image_rubrics.prompt_adherence: Requested objects, count, attributes, material, layout and domain are visible; unobservable details are uncertain.
image_rubrics.image_quality: Usable coherent image without malformed objects, unintended panels, frames, repeated scenes or severe artifacts.

pair_rubrics.activation_specificity: Intended adapter style is visibly supported with the trigger and meaningfully more specific than without it; difference alone is insufficient.
pair_rubrics.preservation: Matched base comparisons show no adapter-induced content/quality regression, including unrelated prompts. Existing base failures are recorded separately.
pair_rubrics.usable_strength: Both adapter conditions at this strength remain usable and satisfy the case expectation.

policy.failure: Any failing adapter-image or pair criterion rejects the candidate for this complete matrix.
policy.uncertainty: Absent failures, any uncertain/unavailable required judgment makes the decision inconclusive.
policy.acceptance: All adapter-image and pair criteria must pass. Base judgments are recorded as comparison evidence, not candidate gates.
policy.promotion: No catalog mutation or production eligibility; candidate lifecycle is separate.

value.limits: Exposed fixed cases, not an independent blind holdout or sampler-parity experiment. Review assertions require method and uncertainty; hashes are not signatures.

_cli.next_action: Inspect every image and matched comparison, then fill the sibling .review.json including uncertainty.

review_metadata.limitations: Exposed fixed cases, one render per condition, small three-work training selection and known prior failures. Not blind, independent gold labels, statistical validation, a parity experiment or numerical determinism. Oil-style specificity and hidden object details remain uncertain where not visible. No training/tuning or promotion.
review_metadata.method: Direct inspection of all 288 images as 36 lossless contact sheets with 512px tiles, two columns plain/trigger and four rows base/0.25/0.5/1.0. Original 512px images 216, 222 and 223 also inspected. All image and matched-comparison judgments retained. Labels and prior baseline failures visible; no optional evaluator invoked. C-02 border screen is unqualified and was not used for quality decisions.

policy.failure: Any failing adapter-image or pair criterion rejects the candidate for this complete matrix.
policy.uncertainty: Absent failures, any uncertain/unavailable required judgment makes the decision inconclusive.
policy.acceptance: All adapter-image and pair criteria must pass. Base judgments are recorded as comparison evidence, not candidate gates.
policy.promotion: No catalog mutation or production eligibility; candidate lifecycle is separate.

value.limits: Exposed fixed cases, not an independent blind holdout or sampler-parity experiment. Review assertions require method and uncertainty; hashes are not signatures.
